title: Share page: a user field shows its raw sys_user id to an anonymous visitor — render the neutral placeholder instead
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nLA7wiVY5YWjT9Svr

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding from #31326 (PR #31346, dev report 6716683769: "a user-type field still prints its sys_user id on the share page", code reading only), filed by `domain:ui#1`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade p3, self-graded under the 2026-11-01 ruling (「定级你可以自己决定」): the same display defect class as #31326, an id an anonymous visitor cannot use.

## 维护者速读

分享链接页（`/s/TOKEN`）上，查找字段已改为显示「已关联记录」（#31326）。但「用户」类型字段存的也是一个内部 ID（`sys_user` 的 id），页面仍把这串 ID 原样显示给外部访客。改法与 #31326 相同：有值时显示中性占位，不显示 ID，也不读取用户记录。

## What is wrong

- The spec `FieldType` `user` stores a `sys_user` id (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, the comment beside `'user'`).
- After PR #31346, `SharedRecordFields` (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordFields.tsx`) shows the placeholder only for `lookup` and `master_detail`. A filled `user` field still falls through to the text path and prints the id. This was read in code by the #31326 dev and is not yet measured on a rendered page.

## Expected

- On the share page, a filled `user` field renders a neutral, localized placeholder (reuse `sharedRecord.linkedRecord` if the wording fits, or add one key); an empty one renders empty, as today. The id is never shown.
- No change to the resolve answer, and no read of `sys_user` (showing the person's name is the same security-boundary question as option B on #27200).
- Pins: a filled user field shows the placeholder and no id; CONTROL: a text field renders as today. Measure first that the resolve projection serves `type: 'user'` for such a field.

Lane: `domain:ui`. Related: #31326, PR #31346, #27200.
